resourceDescriptions.Wood: Gathered from forests and used for building
resourceDescriptions.Food: Consumed each year to keep units and populace healthy and alive
resourceDescriptions.Stone: Used for building sturdier structures or upgrades
resourceDescriptions.Iron: Includes the entirety of its process from smelting ore to solid iron bars
resourceDescriptions.Wealth: Measure of large amounts in funding, either in coin, credit, or goods

assetDescriptions.Horses: Herd of horses or equivalent, of which purchasable or levied mounts can be drawn from
assetDescriptions.Weapons: Martial weapons, used to equip players and units
assetDescriptions.Tools: Necessities needed for special projects or repairs
assetDescriptions.Population: Large group of individuals/families, each can produce a Militia if levied
assetDescriptions.Medicine: Used for creating healer's kits and potions, as well as staving off mass disease
assetDescriptions.Ships: A few ships, of which purchasable or requisitioned boats and ships can be drawn from

societyDescriptions.Unrest: Measures kingdom strife, when it exceeds Pop count, rebellion breaks out
societyDescriptions.Diplomacy: Relations and public image, used to initiate and pull in favors from other factions
societyDescriptions.Loyalty: Used to offset otherwise unpopular moves, generates Unrest when below Pop count
societyDescriptions.Piety: Used to initiate and pull in favors from religious factions, may provide divine bonuses
societyDescriptions.Dread: Used to match or stave off threats, lowers Loyalty by 1 for every 1 above Pop count
societyDescriptions.Intrigue: Used to infiltrate, sabotage, spy, or scout out regions and realms
